tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs zhi khro rnam rol bzhugs// ༄༅// 'jam dpal zhi khro rnams par rol pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi la zhi dang khro bo la// khro sogs rnam 'phrul bye ba brgyas// gdul bya 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa// 'jam pa'i dpal gyis bdag skyongs shig /de yi go 'phang thob bya'i phyir// de nyid la ni phyag 'tshal nas// de mnyes byed pa sgrub pa'i thabs// de yi rjes bzung gsung bzhin bshad// de la dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang dang rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'di nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang 'jam dpal du mos pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'jam dpal khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ de la phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥhās mchod yon/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis 'thor 'thung*/ oṃ ku mā ra rū pi ni dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ hes me tog oṃ hri ha ha he hes bdug spos/ oṃ dīpta lo tsa na wi kṛ tā na na ma hā aṭṭa ha sa na de ni dīpta dīpta ya swā hās mar me/ oṃ wi kṛ tā na na duṣṭa satwa da ma ka ga gas dri/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba satwa da ma ka nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas te/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ bde ba chen pos mchod nas/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bgyi// skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsal// mi byed par yang spyan sngar brjod// de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang*// bdag gis bde 'gror yongs su bsngo// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro// sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral// byang chub gnas la dgod par bgyi// byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed// ces lan gsum brjod/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ dza ya dza ya/ su dza ya bi shwa rū pa dha ri/ gatstsha gatstsha/ sarba daṃṣṭ+rī tya te/ ta thā ga te nāṃ/ sarba shuddha shrī bi dza ya ma ma karyaṃ ku ru swā hās gshegs su gsol/

oṃ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas srung ba'i 'khor lo bskyed pa'i nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog lta bu'i steng du/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dhīḥlas rang nyid 'jam dpal dmar ser/ phyag g.yas pa ral gri/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma'i 'od kyis bdag nyid zhu nas gdan nyi ma la thim/ de las 'od kyi rtser 'jam dpal bzhugs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ gdug pa can thams cad btul zhing dag pa dang*/ sems can smin par byas/ slar 'dus nyi ma la thim/ yang 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas/ rig ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ nyi ma la thim pas nyi ma de nyid dpag tshad 'bum gyi tshad tsam du gyur pa'i dbus su dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i gzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lha snam dmar po/ nang gi grwa bzhir bum pa brgyad dang*/ ka pā la bzhis mtshan pa/ dbul le tshe dgu pa lha'i gnas bzhi bcu zhe dgur/ rlung dang*/ padma dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan bsam/ de'i steng du dbus nas rim pa bzhin/ dhīḥ.oṃ ām̐ dzrīm̐ kham̐ sam̐ ram̐ dham̐ kam̐ le tshe dgu la'o// lha snam la shar nas rim pa bzhin/ tim̐ kham̐ maim̐ dzñām̐ wam̐ tsam̐ dzñām̐/ lho nas rim pas/ bam̐ yam̐ mum̐ dham̐ ram̐ tīm̐ hem̐ dzām̐/ nub nas rim pas/ pām̐ sam̐ rām̐ rām̐ sām̐ ram̐ sum̐ bam̐/ byang nas rim pa bzhin/ kem̐ ham̐ gam̐ dzñām̐ sam̐ mam̐ am̐ rnams dang*/ shar nas sgo bzhir/ am̐ pām̐ spham̐ gham̐/ me nas grwa bzhir/ sum̐ um̐ hūm̐ ām̐ rnams bsam/ de dag las 'od zer phar 'phros/

rang rang gi rigs kyi sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas lhar gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid 'jam dpal nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog lta bu/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pusti dang bcas pa'i utpa la 'dzin pa/ shar nas gti mug rdo rje/ phra ma rdo rje/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje/ shar lho nas sems ma rdo rje ma/ rin chen rdo rje ma/ chos kyi rdo rje ma/ las kyi rdo rje ma/ shar du rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje ral gri/ byams pa/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi sku/ ngag gi dbang phyug zla 'od ye shes mtsho'o// lhor rdo rje sna tshogs// rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje srung ba/ rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje rgyu/ drwa ba can gyi 'od do// nub tu rdo rje smra ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje legs pa/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje nyi 'od/ rdo rje nyi ma'o// byang du rdo rje dpal/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ spos kyi glang po/ ye shes tog 'gro ba 'dul ba/ rgya mtsho'i blo gros/ blo gros mi zad pa/ bdud rtsi 'od do// shar sgo la sogs par/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu'o// shar lho nas rdo rje gnod mdzes/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o// shar dang shar lho pa thams cad sku mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lho dang lho nub pa ser po/ rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub dang nub byang ba dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ byang dang byang shar ba ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa thams cad kyis thugs kar pusti 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ nyi ma'i nyams can du bltas pa de la dmigs pa gtad de yid gzung ngo*// de nas sems can gyi khams rab 'byams la bltas pas gshin rje la sogs pa gdug pa can rnams zhi bas mi 'dul zhing khro bos 'dul ba'i phyir/

shin tu gdug pa drag po dag /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te// 'di mkhyen rdo rje can nyid ni// khro bor de bzhin gshegs skur gyur// hūm̐ zhes brjod nas/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer spyan drangs pa nyi ma la thim/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal la thim pas/ lha rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re rer gyur/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi tshogs spyan drangs/ nyi ma rnams la thim zhing*/ chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar nyi ma rnams kyi steng du sa bon du gyur ba ni/ sngags kyi rim pa ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na/ zhes pa dang*/ yakṣe yatstsha ni rā ma ya/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yakṣe ya/ ya mānta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rnams su gyur/ de rnams las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi tshogs spyan drangs/ yi ge rnams la thim pas phyag mtshan du gyur pa ni/ sngar gyi rim pas/ gri gug mgo lag pa/ rgyu ma/ rkang pa/ thod pa/ thod tshal/ ro ras/ gsal shing gis phug pa'i skyes bu/ gri gug mtshon rtse gcig pa/ gtun shing*/ chu gri rtse gcig rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ ma he/ wa/ dgra st+wa/ mda'/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭwā?ṃ ga 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ phag bong bu/ rdo rje rtse lnga/ rnge'u chung*/ phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ rnga mo/ khyi/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang chen ko rlon/ tho ba/ mdung*/ me thab/ lug ce spyang*/ bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ bya rog ne tso/ khyung*/ khwa/ ri skegs/ bzhad rnams su gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ phyag mtshan so so la thim pas lhar gyur pa ni/

dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o// 'khor rnams ni/ shar gyi re mig nas brtsams nas rim pas/ rdo rje mgo rdo rje lag pa/ rdo rje rgyu ma/ rdo rje rkang pa/ rdo rje thod pa/ rdo rje thod tshal/ rdo rje ro ras/ rdo rje gsal shing ngo*// lha snam gyi lha rnams ni rim pas/ rdo rje gri gug rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje gtun shing*/ rdo rje chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje ma he/ rdo rje wa'o// rdo rje dgra st+wa/ rdo rje mda'/ rdo rje dbyug pa/ rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga rdo rje 'khor lo/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje phag rdo rje bong bu'o// rdo rje rdo rje/ rdo rje rnge'u chung*/ rdo rje phub/ rdo rje gzhu/ rdo rje dril bu/ rdo rje rlung ras/ rdo rje rnga mo/ rdo rje khyi'o// rdo rje sdigs mdzub/ rdo rje 'phan/ rdo rje glang lpags/ rdo rje tho ba/ rdo rje mdung thung*/ rdo rje me thab/ rdo rje lug rdo rje spyang ki'o// rdo rje bya rgod/ rdo rje 'ug pa/ rdo rje bya rog rdo rje ne tso'o// rdo rje khyung*/ rdo rje khra/ rdo rje ri skegs/ rdo rje bzhad do// de rnams thams cad sku mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ liṅga gyen du rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pas ma he mnan pa/ nyams dang rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad gtso bo dang 'dra'o// de nas lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon dgod/ mig tu kṣiṃ las sa'i snying po dkar/ rna bar dzrīṃ las phyag na rdo rje sngo/ snar kham̐ las nam mkha'i snying po ser/ khar gam̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar/ dpral bar kaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel ljang*/ snying gar sam̐ las kun tu bzang po sngon po dang*/

spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sngon po rnams bskyed la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas sa bon gyi yi ge rnams las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drang*/ de la snga ma bzhin mchod/ rang gi snying ga nas sgo ba bzhi spros pas/ ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ gṛdhra badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra u lū ka badzra pā shya hrīḥ oṃ kā ka badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ shu ka badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes brjod do// yang 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin// oṃ badzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang bkra shis brjod/ bgegs bskrad mchod pas mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des lha thams cad kyi lus gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo phyag gnyis pas dbur brgyan par bsams nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la bstim mo// de nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myangs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams tshim par bsams nas/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam zhing*/

gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// longs spyod yul du du mar snang*// shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no// 'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la// rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol// gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la// dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol bar mdzod// reg bya 'gag pa med pa la// mi g.yo bzhin du rol du gsol// ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod// ces pas mchod nas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// la sogs pas bstod nas/ lha mo de dag dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ba spu'i bu gar thim par bsgoms la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa la gtad de mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis spel/ phrin las bzhi bsgrubs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye ba'i snying po rnams bzla'o// 'khor rnams kyi sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ oṃ badzra shi raḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra hasta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ant+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka pā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsa sha ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shma shā ni ka ra pa tā ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shū la bi na pu ru ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra karta ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bhiṇḍa pā ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mu sa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tstshu ri ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra karṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ma hirṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shriṃ ga la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ku tha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra daṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badzra kha ṭwāṃ ga hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pā ra ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra garda bā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍā ma ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pha la ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dha nuḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra wa ta pa ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra uṣṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shwa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tardza ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tri pa daṃ ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra nā ga tsarma hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra muṅka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kunda hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra agni kuṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra me ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shwa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gṛdhra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra u lū ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shu ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra maṇḍi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra se na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ma hā sha ku ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sa ra sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsang sngags rnams ci nus pa bzla'o// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma/ yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi dbus su yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ sgyed pu'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu mu las dri chu/ nub byang du ma las rakta/ byang shar du shu las byang sems/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus nas rim pas/ ya kṣe ma me da/ bsams nas/ de las 'od 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams bzhu/ yig 'bru lnga las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus/ yig 'bru dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du thim zhing*/

'dres pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo skad cig la dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs la mdun bskyed la bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad bkug pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu gnas par bsgoms la/ sngags gsum gyi mthar/ i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba bighnān sha trūn mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang*/ oṃ oṃ bhu tsa ra naṃ ya satwa la tsa ra naṃ man kha tsa ra ni/ ta pūrba a dhi gha naṃ/ ka dakṣi ni/ a di gha naṃ/ hūm̐ pashtsi ma a dhi ga ni phaṭa/ utta ra a dhi gha naṃ/ oṃ i hrīḥ yaṣṭ+riḥb wi ku kṛ i ta a/ na ni nā ba hūm̐ bho/ phaṭa sarba bhū te bhya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bdun gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la phul la/ mchod cing bstod nas phrin las bcol la dngos grub gnang bar bsams nas/ bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol te gtor ma gtong ngo*// de nas gtor ma ltar kha zas byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi rdo rje 'jigs byed du mos te/ lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod na/ snying gar lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bla ma bzhugs pa dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs ma lus pa dmigs shing*/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis/ bza' btung rnams bsreg rdzas kyi tshul du dmigs la/ me'i thab khung du phul bas/ 'khor 'das kyi lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing*/ sdang zhen med par longs spyad do// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/

rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lo mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ gzhal yas khang lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa/ lha rnams 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni 'dod chags dag cing 'dul ba'i phyir/ liṅga gyen du rgyas pa/ zhe sdang dag cing 'dul bas phyag sum cu so bzhi/ ā li rnam par dag pas zhabs bcu drug sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rdzogs pas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas phyag mtshan dang gdan sna tshogs pa sprul pa du ma 'phro ba'o// zhes dag pa dran par byas nas/ gzhal yas khang dang 'khor rnams rang la bsdus la/ bdag dang snang ba lha/ brjod pa dang grag pa sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs te/ snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ rang bzhin stong pa chos kyi sku/ ngo bo zung 'jug longs skur dmigs te/ sdang ba dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ dogs pa med pa'i tshul gyis ci bde bar spyad do// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// de nas nub mo gnyid log pa'i tshe/ lha rnams bsdus nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo// gnyid sad pa'i tshe/ chu bur rdol pa'i tshul gyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs la ldang ngo*// khrus ni dbang gi skabs dang 'dra ba nyid do// bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ ji ltar dbugs ni me long la// rang nyid nges par thim pa ltar// de bzhin rnal 'byor yang dag mtha'// yang dang yang du mngon du byed// ces 'byung ba ltar/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyi spro bsdus/ snod bcud dang dkyil 'khor rnams gsal ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ rim gyis bsdu ba byas nas mthar stong pa nyid la zhugs te/

'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de nas rdzogs rim las langs nas/ bskyed rim la 'jug pa'i tshe/ ji ltar chu klung dwangs pa las// nya dag yongs su 'phar ba ltar// de bzhin thams cad stong pa las// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bzhengs par mdzad// ces pa'i tshul gyis skad cig gis lha'i sku sgyu 'phrul drwa bar bzhengs nas/ rnal 'byor gzhan la 'jug par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa mtshams sbyar dang bcas pa'o// las tshogs kyi cho ga zhib mo ni gzhung gzhan du shes par bya'o// brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra che ba/ a mo gha badzra chung ba/ bla ma skyo 'od 'byung*/ rtsang yang dag 'bar/ yang dag rdo rje/ rngog rdo rje rgyal po/ gzi ba don grub ye shes/ khams ston shākya rdo rje/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum rnams so// zhi ba'i mthar thug 'jam pa'i dpal yin te// drag po'i mthar thug rdo rje 'jigs byed dpal// gnyis ka'ang zung 'jug bde ba'i mthar thug dpal// chos tshul 'di ni thabs kyi mthar thug yin// de 'dra bdag gis rnam par bsdebs pa yi// dge bas zung 'jug chen po'i dpal thob nas// srid zhir gnas pa'i 'byung po ma lus pa// zung 'jug bde ba'i dpal la 'god par shog /rdo rje 'jigs byed rtog pa ni// sum brgya pa ste 'jam dpal gyi// rgyud las dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs// cung zad tsam zhig phyung nas btus// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa rgyas pa las/ sgrub pa'i thabs rgya cher gsungs pa'i don/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon la li ta badzra sa mdzad pa'i gzhung nyams su blang ba'i tshul bde bar bkrol ba 'di ni/ sngags 'chang ba'i dge slong 'phags pas shing mo phag gi lo tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ mdo khams kyi sa'i cha tsom mdo gnas gsar zhes bya bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zi ston gzhon nu dpal lo/// /
